picks.headline: Adobe crams multiple AI tools into its experimental camera app
picks.excerpt: Adobe adds a generative 'AI Playground' to its experimental Project Indigo camera app, letting mobile shooters remove distractions, apply artistic styles and get real-time photo guidance at the point of capture.
picks.rationale: Most actionable for creatives: generative AI moves into the camera at capture time, changing how designers and photographers shoot and edit on mobile.

picks.headline: Report: OpenAI's first device will be a portable speaker with a camera and sensors
picks.excerpt: New reporting details OpenAI's debut device as a portable, screenless speaker with a camera and other sensors, positioned as a proactive AI companion and the first consumer product from the Ive-led io team.
picks.rationale: High-interest look at OpenAI's Jony Ive-designed first consumer device; 9to5Mac chosen over the duplicate Engadget version to hold Engadget at the outlet cap and diversify sources.

picks.headline: Samsung's new AI Health Assistant makes sense of your device data
picks.excerpt: Samsung launches a beta 'Health Assistant,' an AI chatbot inside Samsung Health that interprets data from Galaxy phones, watches and rings and offers physician-validated wellness guidance across its device ecosystem.
picks.rationale: Fresh ecosystem-level AI feature (distinct from the 07-18 Galaxy Watch hardware tease): an assistant that reads across Samsung's whole phone/watch/ring sensor stack.
